answer: A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in willow, and vine reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 42 aliases, and each one needs its own funded summit account. The per-identity price is 100 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
